prompt: In semver.py implement compare_versions(a, b) returning -1, 0 or 1 for the precedence of two semantic-version strings. A version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optionally followed by -PRERELEASE, optionally followed by +BUILD. MAJOR, MINOR and PATCH are non-negative decimal integers without leading zeros (0 itself is fine). PRERELEASE is one or more dot-separated identifiers; each identifier is non-empty and uses only ASCII letters, digits and hyphen, and an identifier made only of digits must not have a leading zero. BUILD is one or more dot-separated non-empty identifiers of ASCII letters, digits and hyphen (leading zeros allowed). Any input that is not a str or is not a valid version raises ValueError. Precedence: compare MAJOR, then MINOR, then PATCH numerically. If those are equal, a version with a PRERELEASE is lower than the same version without one. Two PRERELEASEs are compared identifier by identifier from the left: two numeric identifiers compare as integers; two non-numeric identifiers compare as plain ASCII strings; a numeric identifier is lower than a non-numeric one; if all shared identifiers are equal, the one with fewer identifiers is lower. BUILD is ignored completely (it never affects the result).
